knowledge.content: Target 1 - AppMetadata struct must be defined in root fyne package (app.go) with exact fields: ID string, Name string, Version string, Build int, Icon Resource
Target 1 - Default metadata values when not explicitly set: ID="com.example", Name="Fyne App", Version="1.0.0", Build=1
Target 1 - SetMetadata function must be in app/meta.go (app sub-package), not root package
Target 1 - App.Metadata() method must be added to App interface, requiring updates to ALL existing App implementations in codebase

Target 2 - Hex color parsing rules: 3-digit (#abc→0xaa,0xbb,0xcc,0xff), 4-digit (#abcd→0xaa,0xbb,0xcc,0xdd with special handling for # prefix), 6-digit (#a1b2c3→0xa1,0xb2,0xc3,0xff), 8-digit (#a1b2c3f4→0xa1,0xb2,0xc3,0xf4). All formats work with or without # prefix
Target 2 - JSON theme color resolution order: check variant-specific colors first (Colors-dark or Colors-light), then generic Colors, then default theme fallback
Target 2 - FromJSON and FromJSONReader must return (fyne.Theme, error). On parse error, return default theme WITH the error (not nil theme)
Target 3 - NewSprintf function location: data/binding/sprintf.go in the binding package
Target 3 - NewSprintf Set() special handling: Bytes type cannot be round-tripped (return error), URI type parsed via storage.ParseURI (not fmt.Sscanf)
Target 3 - StringToStringWithFormat optimization: if format is "%s" (identity), return original binding directly without wrapping
Target 4 - MenuItem fields to add in root fyne package (menu.go): Icon Resource, Shortcut Shortcut (Shortcut interface already exists)

Target 5 - Toolbar constructor return type changes: NewToolbarAction returns *ToolbarAction (not ToolbarItem), NewToolbarSpacer returns *ToolbarSpacer, NewToolbarSeparator returns *ToolbarSeparator. All in widget package.
Target 6 - Container.RemoveAll() must set Objects to nil (not empty slice) and trigger re-layout. Location: root fyne package (container.go)

Target 6 - Entry.SetMinRowsVisible behavior: default is 3 rows for multi-line entries. Setting count to 2 makes it shorter, 5 makes it taller. Only affects MinSize() when count > 0. Location: widget/entry.go
Target 6 - validation.NewAllStrings location: data/validation/all.go. Returns first error encountered, or nil if all validators pass
Target 7 - desktop.App interface location: driver/desktop/app.go with methods SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu) and SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource)
